Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing 2x2 sprite sheet of four poses of ONE character. Output exactly four full right-facing sprites, transparent alpha, equal 2x2 square cells, consistent scale. Keep the soft ivory paper character, large round head with one black oval eye, very short sturdy bent legs, simple shorts, long layered paper cloak. BOTH ARMS AND HANDS remain fully hidden inside cloak. No visible hands, fingers, elbows, sleeves. Do not redesign character. No labels, ground, shadows, motion lines.
REQUEST: redraw torso and head into a clear LOW FORWARD sprint toward the RIGHT: shoulder/head displaced rightward and lowered relative to hips, torso axis approximately 30 degrees forward from vertical, about 15 degrees more forward than reference. Eye looking forward right. Maintain rounded head, short body and legs, don't stretch them. Cloak swept backward with its existing layered shape. Not a rigid rotation of the whole sprite: feet remain naturally posed for horizontal running, ground horizontal, and head/torso pitch forward with neck integrated. Preserve each frame's distinct original leg phase and the same four reading-order poses. Crucial leg identity: near leg is light ivory, far leg is muted darker warm taupe (20% darker), consistently across all drawings. Clear short thighs, bent knees and small feet, never noodle limbs. Low forward movement, NOT high jumping. Use actual transparent alpha, no colored edge debris or background.
These are old frames 1,2,3,4. In 1 and 2 the BRIGHT NEAR leg folds forward with knee ahead, DARK FAR leg extends behind. In 3 bright near leg unfolds downward-forward for landing, dark far leg folds behind. In 4 bright near foot supports under/a little ahead of hip, dark far knee is bent behind and begins recovery. Frame2 should skim low, not leap upward. Keep original horizontal stance role while leaning torso forward.

Exactly 2x2 square sprite cells, genuine transparent alpha, no labels, no grid, no scenery, no shadow. Consistent head/body scale with references. RIGHT-facing LOW FORWARD sprint with tilted neck/torso, big round ivory head and black oval eye, long layered flowing paper cloak, plain shorts and short solid bent legs. Reference1 is original poses1,2,3,4 in reading order. Reference2 is original poses5,6,7,8. We need two intervening drawings between pose4 (reference1 bottom-right) and pose5 (reference2 top-left), AND two intervening drawings between pose8 (reference2 bottom-right) and pose1 (reference1 top-left). DO NOT copy endpoints. At the endpoint4 the bright near foot is ahead supporting, dark far leg is folded behind; endpoint5 has bright near foot behind supporting, dark far knee folded forward. DARK FAR recovering knee has swung from behind to beneath pelvis, foot tucked back and raised, visibly dark behind bright shin. Two feet separated enough to read, NOT both facing the same pose.

It has not yet reached endpoint5's full forward fold.

BOTTOM-RIGHT = second third between8 and1: DARK FAR supporting foot somewhat BEHIND hip pushing backward with sole/toe touching ground; BRIGHT NEAR knee just IN FRONT of hip, thigh forward, knee deeply bent, near foot lifted under knee.
The two rows are opposite half-strides, NOT four identical leg poses. Top row's weight-bearing leg is BRIGHT. Bottom row's weight-bearing leg is DARK. Show the two-step migration of both feet and both knees through passing. Heads stay low, no jumping. Keep long cape tails swept left; all sprites fully within equal cells with generous padding.

Same short compact legs, near limb bright ivory and far limb darker taupe. BOTH ARMS remain invisible.
All four need COMPACT PASSING poses with BOTH KNEES UNDER THE HIP, not wide strides. Hip = where upper thighs join underneath center of short cloak, NOT the head center. Head diameter = D. All feet must be within 0.35D horizontally of the hip; the final wide stride endpoint is NOT shown here.
TOP LEFT: bright support thigh tilts slightly BACK, bright support shin down, bright flat sole directly UNDER HIP (move it LEFT from current picture by roughly 0.2 head diameters). The two knees overlap at passing but both feet visible at different heights.
TOP RIGHT: bright supporting foot just 0.25D BEHIND hip on the ground (dramatically shorten current rear extension, bring foot RIGHT by about half a head width). Bright support knee softly bent. DARK swing knee just 0.2D IN FRONT of hip and lifted, dark foot tucked under hip, not yet far forward. This is a small increment from top-left, not end-stride.
BOTTOM LEFT: mirror leg ROLES of top-left, not direction. Dark supporting flat sole directly under hip (move left by 0.2D), bright swinging knee under hip, calf folded back, bright lifted foot0.25D behind hip. Near bright leg visibly overlays far dark leg.
BOTTOM RIGHT: dark supporting foot just0.25D behind hip grounded (shorten current rear extension, move foot right by half a head width). Bright swing knee just0.2D in front of hip, bright foot tucked under hip, not far forward.
Ground same in every cell. Short bent knees, feet with heels/soles, no tubular limbs. No added labels, arrows, guides or background. Four complete sprites exactly layout as input.
